audit.whatIsWrong: The page's entire tracking system was built on a FABRICATED ability: 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)'. Hwei has no such ability. His crowd-control palette is Subject: Torment (E), 12/11.5/11/10.5/10, whose spells are Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss and Crushing Maw.
audit.why: packet.defects already noted the page never names a real Hwei ability. The invented name appeared in focus.text, winCon, enemyWin, loading, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.feeding, dosFull[2].d and four report entries — so a player tracking 'Subject: Fear' is watching for something that does not exist.
audit.corrected: Every reachable instance replaced with Subject: Torment (E) and its 12s-at-rank-1 cooldown. Subject: Serenity's 18s shield added where the burst is planned, per missingInteractions shield-absorbs-burst.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five rows disagreed across layers: phases[].side read Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill while content win[] and packet.levelChart read Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Lissandra/Lissandra/Hwei.
audit.why: Levels 1-5 are a poke skill-check with no all-in on either side; 6 and the first item are Lissandra's because Frozen Tomb is point-and-click against a champion with no dash; two items in, his layered zones out-range a single engage.
audit.corrected: Five sides realigned as one atomic group, with phases[0].why and phases[6].why rewritten so the sentence agrees with the new verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[6].why claimed 'Late Liss opens every fight' on a row the chart gives to Hwei.
audit.why: This is exactly the row-argues-with-itself defect. The content layer's whys[6] already said Hwei out-scales.
audit.corrected: The why now states the side-lane-pick condition instead of a Lissandra win.

audit.why: It is the field that carries real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Subject: Torment 12s to 10s, Subject: Serenity 18s, Frozen Tomb 120s stated.

edits.before: Q-shatter the wave and chip his melee step-ups — your early Q harass is better than the lane gives it credit for.
edits.after: Level 1 is even: he paints from long range and you Q-shatter at 725, but neither side has a kill threat yet.

edits.before: Survive the poke war and convert rivers into pick-offs his range can't answer. Track Subject: Fear (CC Paints) before every commit and keep the wave where your pattern works.
edits.after: Survive the poke war and convert rivers into pick-offs his range can't answer. Track Subject: Torment (E) before every commit — 12s at rank 1 — and keep the wave where your pattern works.

edits.before: Hwei wins by landing Subject: Fear (CC Paints), denying your pattern, and renting you the lane at a range markup.
edits.after: Hwei wins by rooting you off Subject: Torment, shielding through your commit with Serenity, and out-ranging you all game.

edits.before: - Lissandra vs Hwei - Track: Hwei Subject: Fear (CC Paints). - Hold W for his gap-close — the root IS the matchup. - Engage only on Subject: Fear (CC Paints)’s cooldown. - Spend your ultimate on kill windows only.
edits.after: - Lissandra vs Hwei - Track: Hwei Subject: Torment (E), 12s at rank 1. - Hold W for his step-up — the root IS the matchup. - Engage only when the CC palette is down. - Spend your ultimate on kill windows only.

edits.before: - Hwei Subject: Fear (CC Paints): matchup-defining — All his crowd control lives on the E palette — dodge the fear/root and the burst never chains. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your R Frozen Tomb (self-cast) like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Subject: Torment (E) is his crowd-control palette, 12s at rank 1 and 10s at rank 5 — every root and fear comes off it, so nothing chains while it is down. - Subject: Serenity shields him on 18s. - Frozen Tomb is 120s at rank 1 and goes to kill windows only.

edits.before: If Hwei gets one kill, respect Subject: Fear (CC Paints) and reset to farming. Two kills: play for the team, not for solo redemption — farm with Q shatters and stay relevant through self-R utility.
edits.after: If Hwei gets one kill, respect Subject: Torment and reset to farming — it is 12s at rank 1. Two kills: play for the team, not solo redemption — farm with Q shatters and stay relevant through self-R utility.

edits.before: Carry through picks — claw-root-tomb converts vision into kills better than any control mage; the map shrinks every time your E is up.
edits.after: Carry by closing distance he cannot restore — Hwei has no dash, so a claw into a 450 root ends the poke war permanently.

edits.before: Ahead, hunt: claw into every river skirmish first, tomb the carry, and snowball picks — Hwei farming under tower can't stop a roaming Lissandra.
edits.after: Ahead, roam: Hwei has no dash at all, so crash the wave and claw to a side lane — he cannot follow you and cannot punish the crash.

edits.before: All his crowd control lives on the E palette — dodge the fear/root and the burst never chains. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Your Q is 725 and its shards pass through the target, so one spear hits him and the caster minions in the same line.

edits.before: Q-shatter his wave contact, and when he steps to punish, W-root into full rotation and walk — the root tax makes every aggressive step expensive.
edits.after: Subject: Torment is 12s at rank 1 — take your one claw window while his crowd control is spent, then leave on the same E before it returns.

edits.before: Hwei wastes Subject: Fear (CC Paints) — that is your full-commit window.
edits.after: Inside 450 range his ult and his painted zones do nothing for him.

edits.before: Clawing in with W on cooldown 'to poke' — an engage tool spent on chip damage is a Lissandra standing in melee range with no ice left.
edits.after: Dark ice spent on painted chip damage leaves you nothing for the moment a Subject: Torment root actually lands on you at 12s.

edits.before: Survive the poke war and convert rivers into pick-offs his range can't answer. Track Subject: Fear (CC Paints) before every commit and keep the wave where your pattern works.
edits.after: Survive the poke war and convert rivers into pick-offs his range can't answer. Track Subject: Torment (E) before every commit — 12s at rank 1 — and keep the wave where your pattern works.

edits.before: Track Hwei’s Subject: Fear (CC Paints): All his crowd control lives on the E palette — dodge the fear/root and the burst never chains. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Hwei’s Subject: Torment (E): every root and fear he has comes off that palette, 12s at rank 1 — while it is down, his burst never chains.

edits.before: R (Frozen Tomb) is your all-in enabler: flash-R or Q-into-R locks him before he can chain his QQ trap or ult, turning a poke lane into a kill window.
edits.after: R (Frozen Tomb) is your all-in enabler: flash-R or Q-into-R locks him before Subject: Torment or his ult can answer, turning poke into a kill window.

edits.before: Bait his EE (disrupt) then flash-R the moment it's down
edits.after: Bait Subject: Torment, then flash-R while it is down

notes: The fabricated name 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' ALSO survives in report[3].t and report[9].t. The template sweep caps report[] rewrites at two per matchup and both were spent on report[1] and report[5]; those two entries still need the name replaced with Subject: Torment (E). Flagging rather than exceeding the cap. Content win[0..6] already matched packet.levelChart, so only the stale full-layer sides moved; no win[N] twins existed to edit. Content spikes[0]/spikes[3] and wants.foe[] use invented palette shorthand ('QW pool', 'WW terrain', 'EE disrupt', 'RQ layering') that does not map to Riot's sub-spell names — see questionsForUser. Not asserted: which specific Torment sub-spell (Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss, Crushing Maw) a Hwei is most likely to hold in lane, since the kit gives cooldowns only for the palette, not per sub-spell.
